notes: All civil retirees and pensioners in these counts belong to the Union's own civil servant regime (RPPS, Constitution art. 40), not to INSS/RGPS. Commissioned-only staff, temporaries, public employees and elected mandates are RGPS (Constitution art. 40, para. 13). Military retirees and pensioners belong to the SPSMFA, a third system.

RPPS counts only career posts and members; it excludes commissioned-only staff, who are on the payroll. Dividing a branch payroll by these counts overstates cost per person, most of all in the Legislative (Câmara: about 11,530 commissioned staff without tie in Dec 2025).

pensioners = beneficiaries (people receiving a pension) in the RPPS tables, inferred because each pensioner has own sex and age; the document does not say 'instituidor'. Military and Anexo I sources give both founders and beneficiaries explicitly.
The URLs on gov.br/planejamento return an HTML page; append /@@download/file to get the PDF.
RPPS executive retirees fell by 25,406 between July 2024 and July 2025; the report pages read do not explain it. Do not show it as a trend without an explanation.
DF police and firefighters paid through FCDF have no headcount in these sources.
Dates differ by source: civil RPPS July 2025, military May 2025, Câmara and Senado December 2025, DPU July 2026, CNJ December 2024. Do not add across sources.

judiciary_cost_per_person_cnj.what: Total monthly spending per person: remuneration, indemnities, social and pension charges, income tax, travel (tickets and per diem); payments to retirees and pensioners are included in the calculation. It is not a salary.

superior_courts.name: Tribunais Superiores
superior_courts.quote: despesas médias mensais dos Tribunais Superiores com pagamento de magistrados(as) e servidores(as). É importante esclarecer que os valores incluem os pagamentos de remunerações, indenizações, encargos sociais, pre- videnciários, imposto de renda, despesas com viagens a serviço (passagens aéreas e diárias16), o que não corresponde, portanto, aos salários, tampouco aos valores recebidos pelos(as) servidores(as) públicos. Dito isso, observa-se que as despesas representam uma média mensal de R$ 101,6 mil por magistrado(a); de R$ 27,3 mil por servidor(a); de R$ 7,4 mil por terceirizado(a); e de R$ 1,4 mil por estagiário(a).

judiciary_cost_per_person_cnj.electoral_note: Electoral Justice pays only the electoral gratification to its judges; their salaries come from their home courts, so its per-magistrate figure is not comparable.
judiciary_cost_per_person_cnj.caveat_quote: No cálculo, estão considerados os pagamentos com inativos e pensionistas, o que pode acarretar diferenças quando feita a comparação entre tribunais, uma vez que o pagamento de tais vencimentos pode ocorrer às expensas do órgão ou por meio de fundos de pen- são, neste caso, não computados.
judiciary_cost_per_person_cnj.not_available: No equivalent all-in cost per person is published for the Legislative or the Executive; do not rank these figures against the RPPS averages.
